description: Source code for test utilities related to trace2 event testing in a Git-like environment, including functions to simulate process exit, error reporting, child process management, command execution, and trace2 event generation.

methods.name: get_i
methods.description: Parses an integer from a string, returning MyOk or MyError.

methods.name: ut_001return
methods.description: Simulates process exit with a specified code.

methods.name: ut_002exit
methods.description: Exits process with a specified code.

methods.name: ut_003error
methods.description: Sends error events with provided messages.

methods.name: ut_004child
methods.description: Runs a child process and waits for it to finish.

methods.name: ut_005exec
methods.description: Executes a git command, possibly replacing the current process.

methods.name: ut_010bug_BUG
methods.description: Exercises bug() and BUG() macros with formatted message.

methods.name: ut_101timer_thread_proc
methods.description: Thread procedure for multi-threaded timer test.

methods.name: ut_200counter
methods.description: Tests adding values to a counter.

methods.name: print_usage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the test utility.

methods.name: cmd__trace2
methods.description: Main command function to run specific trace2 test cases based on arguments.
